notes.title: Released!
notes.notes:
Hello!

We’re happy to announce that Nox Terrorem: Lost Souls is now available for purchase! Thank you all so much for sticking around and being patient while we worked everything out.

Additionally, the soundtrack is now available here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1624810/Nox_Terrorem_Lost_Souls_Official_Soundtrack/?beta=0]Official Soundtrack on Steam[/url]
And anywhere else you can buy or stream music!

If you find any bugs or issues, report them in this thread: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1566150/discussions/0/3092263995635324721/]Bugs and Issues Thread[/url]

Thank you all again! We’re so very grateful for your support.

~The Talented Foxes team

notes.title: State of Release II
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I've got great news! We were able to work out the review issue and can now confirm our release date: [b]May 31, 2021[/b]! Feel free to wishlist the game so you know the moment it releases! ːsteamhappyː

Additionally, I'm hanging out in the community hub if you have questions: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1566150/discussions/]Community Hub[/url]

The Steam release of the soundtrack will also be on May 31, you can check that out here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1624810/Nox_Terrorem_Lost_Souls_Official_Soundtrack/]Soundtrack[/url]


Lastly, I want to thank you for sticking around and being patient while we sorted out this situation, it means a lot and we are eternally grateful.

~Jake

notes.title: State of Release
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Jake here with some unfortunate news. At present we are still awaiting the approval from Steam to release. I'm not sure how much longer we need to wait, and our fingers are still crossed for a release occurring today, but that gets less likely with every passing hour.

We are very sorry that we may not be able to release today, and we ask for your patience and understanding as we try to figure things out and get this game to all of you. We've discussed some backup dates for release and we'll get that information out when/if it's needed. Until then, thank you all for sticking around, it means so much.

For now, if you'd like to listen to the soundtrack, here's a link for that: https://distrokid.com/hyperfollow/jakemenear/nox-terrorem-lost-souls-original-game-soundtrack

I'm sorry I don't have better news. Thank you all.
~Jake
